guide.title: Your day has a soundtrack.
guide.description: Start with the way you listen. A quiet corner, a morning commute or a room full of friends — find the setup that fits the moment.
guide.imageAlt: Over-ear headphones in soft pink light
paragraphs: A good starting point is your listening space. Consider whether you want to listen on your own or share music with others, and how much room you have.
Then compare comfort, connections and the specifications supplied by the seller. Photography can show a design direction, but it cannot tell you how a product sounds.

steps.title: Make it personal
steps.description: For solo listening, compare headphone fit and comfort before looking at extra features.

steps.title: Give your room a voice
steps.description: For shared listening, start with your room size and where a speaker can sit.

steps.title: Check the details
steps.description: Discuss compatibility, product details and your requirements with us before requesting a quote.

items.question: How do I request a quote?
items.answer: Use “Request a quote” on the product page to contact us. Share the product you are interested in, quantities and any specific requirements.

items.question: Are the product names and photographs real?
items.answer: The catalog names are demonstration labels. Photos are credited references and may show third-party products; SONO does not claim to manufacture them.

items.question: Can you help me choose a product?
items.answer: Tell us about your listening space, intended use and preferred design. Contact us to discuss suitable products and confirm specifications.
